a: Participant fee €630 including accommodation and meals; a limited number of grants cover the fee (not travel)
dt: Register by Jan 3, 2027; acceptance notices in early February; school Mar 14-19, 2027
e: One-week Les Houches school and workshop (about 50 participants) on non-equilibrium dynamics of one- and two-dimensional quantum fluids on atomic and photonic platforms, with tutorials and invited seminars. Preference goes to applicants who submit a poster abstract and attend the whole school; fee grants are requested by emailing the organizers with a motivation letter.
n: Les Houches 2027: Out-of-Equilibrium Physics in Low-Dimensional Quantum Fluids
unv: Eligible career stages are not stated (the page targets tutorials plus posters); stages gr and pd are assumed from the format. Number of fee grants not stated.
